name: Normal Sinus Rhythm RR Interval Database
description: The Normal Sinus Rhythm RR Interval Database is an interbeat interval time series archive curated by PhysioNet and Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center. It contains beat-to-beat RR interval sequences extracted from 24-hour ambulatory Holter ECG recordings of 54 healthy adult subjects (30 men, aged 28.5 to 76; and 24 women, aged 58 to 73) verified to have normal sinus rhythm. Unlike waveform-level ECG databases, this repository provides filtered and audited interbeat intervals, serving as a dedicated comparative baseline for heart rate variability (HRV) analysis, autonomic nervous system evaluation, and non-linear dynamics research.
